description: This file contains repository classes for various entities in a sports live streaming backend, such as users, profiles, matches, events, emojis, and highlights. It encapsulates database operations using SQLAlchemy, including CRUD, querying, and aggregation functions.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A base class providing common database session management for all repositories.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository for user-related database operations, including creation, retrieval, and update.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository managing user profile data, including creation, retrieval, and updates.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository handling match data, supporting retrieval of matches with various filters and complex queries.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository for event data, facilitating retrieval of events and associated matches.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Repository managing emoji assets and reactions, including reactions summary aggregation.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository for highlight videos or clips, supporting retrieval of highlights and related data.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user in the database, normalizing roles and logging input data.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a user record by its ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a user record by email.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a user record by username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Update existing user fields with new data.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Create a new user profile with specified data.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve user profile by associated user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve user profile by profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Update profile details based on provided data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of matches with optional filtering by status and sport.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Get detailed information for a specific match, including related entities.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Retrieve all currently ongoing matches.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Get matches scheduled within a certain number of days from now.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_more_matches(self, limit: int = 12, offset: int = 0, exclude_ids: List[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieve additional matches for a 'more matches' section with a variety of types and exclusions.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Get a list of events, optionally filtered by sport and featured status.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a specific event with associated matches.

methods.name: get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetch a paginated list of active emojis; fallback to minimal schema if necessary.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a specific emoji asset by its ID.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str, created_at: Optional[datetime] = None)
methods.description: Add a new emoji reaction to an event by a user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Summarize emoji reactions for a specific event, including counts and trending emojis.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieve highlights, optionally filtered by match.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a specific highlight by its ID.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Get the most recent and popular featured highlights.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
